sloka: हा नाथ इति परिक्रुश्य पेततुर् धरणी तले ।सा कोसल इन्द्र दुहिता वेष्टमाना मही तले ॥२-६५-२३॥
transliteration: hā nātha iti parikruśya petatur dharaṇī tale ।sā kosala indra duhitā veṣṭamānā mahī tale ॥2-65-23॥

translations.english: Kausalya, daughter of the lord of Kosala, lay on the ground writhing in pain, coated with dust, and devoid of brightness like a star without radiance fallen from the sky.
